description: Keeps every pinned dependency on its latest release: GitHub Actions (pinned to commit digests), the Go module and toolchain, and the dev tools the Makefile runs with go run pkg@version. Commits and PR titles are Conventional Commits (chore(deps): ..., fix(deps): ...), as commitlint and the PR title check require.

customManagers.description: Dev tools pinned in the Makefile, each annotated with a renovate comment
